Name: Powerful Burglar's Ring
Author: AndyZ0112
Description:
Add 5 new high-tier Burglar's Rings. They can significantly increase the drop rate from monsters.
[b]New features of 1.0: You can find more items when opening chests at the cavern and dungeon while wearing the rings[/b]

[b][size=3]Apprentice Burglar's Ring (the original Burglar's Ring):
[/size][/b]Monsters have a greater chance of dropping loot.

[b][size=3]Novice Burglar's Ring:
[/size]Monsters have 4 times the chance of dropping loot.
[/b]You can find 2 times more items when opening chests at Skull Cavern and Volcano Dungeon.
Craft: Apprentice Burglar's Ring X 2
Shop: AdventureShop  40000

[b][size=3]Skilled Burglar's Ring:
[/size]Monsters have 8 times the chance of dropping loot.
[/b]You can find 4 times more items when opening chests at Skull Cavern and Volcano Dungeon.
﻿Craft:  Novice Burglar's Ring X 2 + ﻿Copper Bar X 10
Shop: AdventureShop  80000

[b][size=3]Expert Burglar's Ring:
[/size]Monsters have 16 times the chance of dropping loot.
[/b]You can find 8 times more items when opening chests at Skull Cavern and Volcano Dungeon.
Craft: Skilled Burglar's Ring X 2 + Iron Bar X 10
Shop: AdventureShop  160000

[b][size=3]Master Burglar's Ring:
[/size][/b]Monsters have 32 times the chance of dropping loot.
[b]You can find 16 times more items when opening chests at Skull Cavern and Volcano Dungeon.
[/b]﻿Craft:  Expert Burglar's Ring X 2 + Gold Bar X 10
Shop: AdventureShop  320000

[b][size=3]Legendary Burglar's Ring:
[/size][/b]Monsters have 64 times the chance of dropping loot.
[b]You can find 32 times more items when opening chests at Skull Cavern and Volcano Dungeon.[/b]
Craft:  Master Burglar's Ring X 2 + Iridium Bar X 10
Shop: AdventureShop  640000


You can disable the "HighTierRings" in CP.PowerfulBurglarRing/﻿﻿config.json or through the "Generic Mod Config Menu", if the high drop rate is not desired. Disabling this will turn off the last 3 rings. (It is recommended to turn it off, high tier rings have crazy drop rates and may impact your gaming experience)
[b]Two new functions: "MineChestsRates" and "VolcanoChestsRates". Enable them to turn on the new feature of finding more items from the chests at Skull Cavern and Volcano Dungeon.
[/b]

The effect [b]Does not [/b]stack with two advanced ﻿Burglar's Rings. However, the effect [b]does stack[/b] with one advanced ring and one original ring ([size=2]Apprentice Burglar's Ring[/size]).


[b][size=4]Changes
[/size][/b][size=2]1.1.0:
[list]
[*]Add a new feature that can increase the number of items when opening chests.
[/list]1.1.1:
[list]
[*]﻿Add three new features: "DropTrinket", "DropCosmetic" and "DropSkillBook". Turn them on or off to change if this mod will impact their drops.
[*]Fix a bug of randomly dropping loot.
[*]Now, it can impact the drop of Prismatic Shard, diamond and Qi beans.
[/list][/size]
